name: orb-reveal
summary: Drag a liquid-glass orb up: it shows your title through the lens, then fountains glass marbles into a heart.
props: Faint hint under the resting orb.
Image URIs for the marbles (app icons, avatars).
Marble pictures when there are no images, each on a bright gradient.
Marbles in the heart (max 60), plus a trail of specks.
The glow while you hold the orb.
Fades in after the reveal: sign-in buttons, a CTA.
The orb settled in a new state.
Root style; give it a screen or a tall card.
behavior: The orb swells and lifts, a blue-violet smile of light glows through it and the headline fades.
Drag up past halfway (or flick) to reveal; drag the small orb down to go back. A quick tap toggles; a hold or a drag back to the start stays put.
Two Skia shaders refract the page under the orb and the title the lens uncovers: magnified middle, mirrored bevel, red/blue split at the edge.
Fountain out of the button on arcs, pop to size and settle into a heart, then drift. Going back down, they float off the top.
The title rides with the orb. It and the footer appear as the orb settles and stay until it is most of the way back down.
A tick when you pick the orb up and a medium impact on reveal.
The orb snaps between states and the marbles appear in place.
Needs CanvasKit loaded (LoadSkiaWeb); without it the revealed copy and footer are shown.
